hero.headline: Custom Homes Built
hero.subheadline: Master craftsmanship in Montana's Flathead Valley. 30 years of hands-on expertise, from design to finish carpentry.
hero.imageAlt: Custom mountain home built by Larchwood Construction in Flathead Valley, Montana

pillars.title: One Project Focus
pillars.text: Your home is the only home we're building. One project at a time means undivided attention, faster decisions, and no delays from competing priorities.

pillars.title: Craftsman's Eye
pillars.text: With 30 years of hands-on experience — from framing to fine finish carpentry — Josh serves as GC, project manager, and lead craftsman. Nothing escapes his eye.

pillars.title: Transparent Process
pillars.text: Every dollar is accounted for. Cost-plus pricing means you see actual costs with no inflated bids or hidden margins. A true partnership built on trust.

featuredWork.heading: Featured
featuredWork.text: Modern mountain homes with craftsman detailing. Every project reflects 30 years of hands-on expertise.

testimonial.quote: I build one home at a time because that's what your project deserves — my full attention, from the first sketch to the final walkthrough. This isn't a production line. It's a partnership.
testimonial.name: Josh Krueger

serviceArea.heading: Serving the
serviceArea.text: From Bigfork and Somers to the south, through Kalispell and Whitefish, up to West Glacier and the North Fork. We build custom homes on undeveloped lots throughout Montana's most beautiful valley.
serviceArea.imageAlt: Larchwood Construction building in Montana's Flathead Valley

cta.heading: Ready to Build Your
cta.text: The best way to start is a conversation. Let's talk about your vision, your land, and whether we're a good fit.
